description: The account's performance report, identical to the website's Performance page: pipeline (discovered, purchased, enriched, imported, duplicates excluded), readiness (prepared, approved, eligible at last launch), delivery (queued, provider-accepted, confirmed delivered, failed, unsettled -- never folded together), engagement (replies, interested, appointments, conversions), cost in credits, and one row per autopilot lane. Read-only; sends nothing and buys nothing. A null value means NOT MEASURED and carries an unavailable_reason -- never report it to the operator as zero.

campaign_id.description: Narrow to one of your campaigns. Not with lane.

lane.description: Narrow to one autopilot lane: 'base' or a Revenue Autopilot profile id. Not with campaign_id.

name: get_performance_summary
